case: Typed CSV round trip for a compound SQLite result
contract: The defect reproduced before the fix: a compound result column with fallback NULL metadata exported INTEGER 42 as plain CSV text, and importing into STRICT ANY restored TEXT.
SQLite CSV file exports tag non-NULL values in fallback-metadata columns with the existing storage-class encoding; unconfigured/default CSV output remains plain text.
The result-file writer and CSV importer round trip INTEGER, TEXT, BLOB, SQL NULL, and text matching the reserved tag prefix into SQLite INTEGER, ANY, and TEXT destination columns.
Native typeof() and returned values confirm INTEGER/TEXT/BLOB/NULL storage classes survive in the STRICT ANY result column, and typed destination columns retain normal affinity behavior.
This proves native SQLite file-writer/import behavior; spreadsheet-application re-import and other computed-expression shapes remain open.
